Read the original page (Biodiversity Heritage Library) · IPNI record

How well the identifier knows it

Of 12 validation photos of Drosera petiolaris (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 8. It gave a confident answer for 8 of them, and 8 of those were right.

Only 34 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera fulva (2 photos)
  • Drosera nitidula (1 photo)
  • Drosera capensis (1 photo)
